title: console: an app whose navigation holds only doc entries lands on a blank page, with no empty state
body:
epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

Filing gate: ① a measured break. Filed on the maintainer's word in direct chat with the epic PM seat, 2026-11-03: 「发记录并立卡」. ⛔ Not a claim.
QA-source: #29672 · studio-authoring.doc-on-app-menu · off-clause
Reader: `domain:ui` (the app landing).
Dedupe: `doc only app blank`. **New.**
type: Bug

Runner reading on `main` at `3482f3d8d2`, isolated too, not re-derived by the PM seat. PUT an app whose navigation has only `type: doc` entries, publish, open `/_console/apps/PKG`: `main` is empty, with no redirect and no empty state, for admin, reader and outsider. An app with an object entry redirects, and an outsider elsewhere is shown an explanatory empty state.

Wanted: the landing opens the first doc, or draws the same empty state.

Links back: #29672.
